name: Switchroom low-temperature ventilation restraint
summary: Restrains the specified ventilation action when the room reaches its defined low-temperature condition.
description: Restrains the specified ventilation action when the room reaches its defined low-temperature condition. Ventilation control coordinates the equipment that manages heat and air movement in an electrical room. A temperature request, a fan command and proof of airflow are separate signals, and the room design determines how they interact.

In a switchroom containing transformers and auxiliary panels, the room controller can supervise fan availability and send an alarm when the documented ventilation duty is not achieved. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Room temperature” at the input and “Ventilation restraint” at the output. Restraint must follow the room-services strategy.
